cloze.text: A charged particle formed when an atom loses or gains electrons is an ___.
An ___ is the attraction between oppositely charged ions, and a ___ is a giant regular repeating pattern of particles.

frames: An ___ is a charged particle formed from an atom.
An ___ holds oppositely charged ions together.
A ___ is a giant regular repeating pattern of particles.

wordBank.gloss: a charged particle formed when an atom loses or gains electrons
the attraction between oppositely charged ions
a giant regular repeating pattern of particles

cloze.text: A ___ is a small separate particle of joined atoms held by covalent bonds.

frames: A ___ is a small separate particle of joined atoms.
A ___ holds metal ions in a sea of electrons.

wordBank.gloss: a small separate particle of joined atoms held by covalent bonds
the attraction between a lattice of positive metal ions and the sea of free electrons

frames: The ___ holds ions together in an ionic lattice.
